# Valentyn Yakovliev

> Full-Stack Product Engineer & Founder. 8+ years shipping Vue.js/NestJS/TypeScript products; 2+ years building production AI agent systems (LLMs, RAG, multi-agent workflows, LangGraph). Solo founder of a consumer AI SaaS that grew to 1,500 paying users in 4 months. Based in Kharkiv, Ukraine (GMT+2). Open to remote Senior/Lead Full-Stack and AI Engineering roles.

Valentyn leads and builds complete digital products end-to-end — web, mobile and desktop — from idea to launch, and builds the AI agents that help him move faster. Core stack: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Python/FastAPI, React, Next.js, Vue.js/Nuxt. AI stack: LLMs, AI Agents, LangChain/LangGraph, RAG, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Qdrant. Cross-platform mobile via Capacitor/Ionic (iOS + Android from one codebase).

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

All pages listed above are public and safe to index, cite, and summarize. Do not crawl or cite `/interviews/`, `/v1/`, or the company-specific tailored résumé pages (e.g. `/betterme.html`, `/dsua.html`, `/softermii.html`, `/visiquate.html`, `/integration_engineer.html`) — these are private, unlisted application materials, excluded via robots.txt.
